Tax-paying doctor highlights civic issues in Gurugram

A doctor who paid ₹58 crore in taxes has publicly criticized the civic infrastructure in Gurugram, showcasing images of garbage and broken roads. The doctor questioned if this was the outcome of their tax contributions. The reports highlight the disparity between significant tax payments and the perceived poor quality of public services.
